note: Written from usp_Insights_Dimension_Risk (sql/08_dimension_risk.sql) as deployed. Verified by SourceMapVerificationTests - every query must return exactly what the report's procedure returned. RiskType codes: 3 = Critical, 0 = High, 1 = Medium, 2 = Low. Overdue is a live figure: a check run later can differ slightly from the report.
setup: -- Step 1. Obligations this user is allowed to see, with their risk level (Compliance.RiskType)
--         (permitted locations and categories; active; nothing deleted).
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#inst') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #inst;
SELECT s.ComplianceInstanceID, s.BranchID, s.RiskType, s.Imprisonment INTO #inst
-- Step 2. Keep only obligations with at least one due date inside the report period (ComplianceScheduleOn.ScheduleOn).
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ComplianceScheduleOn cso
-- Step 3. Obligations overdue right now: past due and not closed, or never touched (ComplianceScheduleOn, ComplianceTransaction).
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#ovd') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #ovd;
-- Step 4. Obligations with a performer named on the obligation itself (ComplianceAssignment, RoleID 3).
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#owned') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #owned;

checks.name: All obligations in the report
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #inst;

checks.name: Sum of all risk-level rows
checks.tables: Every obligation carries exactly one risk level, so this equals R1.
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #inst WHERE RiskType IS NOT NULL;

checks.name: Overdue obligations
checks.tables: Step 3. Live - can move between runs.
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #ovd;

checks.name: Overall overdue rate (%)
query: SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #inst) = 0 THEN 0
ELSE 100.0 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #ovd) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #inst) END AS DECIMAL(5,1)) AS Value;

checks.name: Risk levels that have obligations
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT RiskType) AS Value FROM #inst;

checks.name: Obligations with a possible prison term
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #inst WHERE Imprisonment = 1;

checks.name: Share of prison-term obligations that are Critical (%)
checks.tables: Prison-term obligations with RiskType 3 (Critical) / all prison-term obligations x 100. Blank when there are none.
query: SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN Imprisonment = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN NULL
ELSE 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Imprisonment = 1 AND RiskType = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
/ SUM(CASE WHEN Imprisonment = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) END AS DECIMAL(5,1)) AS Value FROM #inst;

checks.name: A risk level's obligations
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #inst WHERE RiskType = {RowKey};

checks.name: A risk level's overdue obligations
checks.tables: This level's obligations that are in step 3.
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #inst i JOIN #ovd o ON o.ComplianceInstanceID = i.ComplianceInstanceID WHERE i.RiskType = {RowKey};

checks.name: A risk level's overdue rate (%)
checks.tables: Overdue obligations / obligations x 100, for this level.
query: SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN o.ComplianceInstanceID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) END AS DECIMAL(5,1)) AS Value
FROM #inst i LEFT JOIN #ovd o ON o.ComplianceInstanceID = i.ComplianceInstanceID WHERE i.RiskType = {RowKey};

checks.name: A risk level's gap to the overall overdue rate (points)
checks.tables: K3 - R4. Blank for a level with no obligations.
query: SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE
CAST(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN o.ComplianceInstanceID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL(5,1))
- CAST(100.0 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #ovd) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #inst) AS DECIMAL(5,1)) END AS Value
FROM #inst i LEFT JOIN #ovd o ON o.ComplianceInstanceID = i.ComplianceInstanceID WHERE i.RiskType = {RowKey};

checks.name: A risk level's obligations with no performer on the obligation itself
checks.tables: This level's obligations not in step 4. Most still have a performer on each due date (ComplianceScheduleOn.Performerid).
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #inst i LEFT JOIN #owned w ON w.ComplianceInstanceID = i.ComplianceInstanceID
WHERE i.RiskType = {RowKey} AND w.ComplianceInstanceID IS NULL;

checks.name: A risk level's obligations with a possible prison term
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #inst WHERE RiskType = {RowKey} AND Imprisonment = 1;

checks.name: A risk level's overdue obligations with a possible prison term
checks.tables: Compliance.Imprisonment = 1 and overdue now, this level.
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #inst i JOIN #ovd o ON o.ComplianceInstanceID = i.ComplianceInstanceID
WHERE i.RiskType = {RowKey} AND i.Imprisonment = 1;

checks.name: Locations where a risk level applies
checks.tables: Distinct CustomerBranch of this level's obligations.
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT BranchID) AS Value FROM #inst WHERE RiskType = {RowKey};

checks.name: Critical level's overdue rate (%)
query: SELECT CAST(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN o.ComplianceInstanceID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS DECIMAL(5,1)) AS Value
FROM #inst i LEFT JOIN #ovd o ON o.ComplianceInstanceID = i.ComplianceInstanceID WHERE i.RiskType = 3;

checks.name: All overdue obligations with a possible prison term
checks.tables: Compliance.Imprisonment = 1 and overdue now, every level.
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #inst i JOIN #ovd o ON o.ComplianceInstanceID = i.ComplianceInstanceID WHERE i.Imprisonment = 1;
